name: What causes delays in luxury material installation?

mainEntity.name: Why do premium stone, tile, and fixture installations get delayed more often than standard remodels?
mainEntity.text: Why do premium stone, tile, and fixture installations get delayed more often than standard remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury material installation is more likely to face delays because the process has more dependencies. Imported slabs, special-order fixtures, and custom millwork often have longer lead times than stock materials. Once materials arrive, they may still require fabrication, templating, or final verification before installation can begin. Delays also happen when earlier work is incomplete, such as framing, plumbing, waterproofing, or electrical rough-in. If the installer discovers that the room is out of square or that dimensions have changed, the selected materials may need to be adjusted or re-ordered. High-end projects are especially sensitive to schedule slips because multiple trades often depend on the same material delivery. Homeowners should ask for a realistic timeline that includes order dates, fabrication, delivery, installation, and contingency time for corrections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Delays often come from long lead times, custom fabrication, shipping damage, design changes, and site conditions discovered during installation. Luxury work depends on tightly coordinated steps, so one delayed item can hold up several trades and push back the entire schedule.
